svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How Google cut back rich results
svg.desc: Timeline of changes to Google rich results. August 2023, FAQ rich results limited to government and health sites. September 2023, HowTo rich results deprecated. June 2025, phase-out of 7 types announced, including Course Info and Claim Review. September 2025, 6 of them removed from Search Console reports and the Rich Results Test.
svg.text: How Google cut back rich results
Changes announced on the Google Search Central Blog
Book Actions, Course Info, Claim Review, Estimated Salary,
Learning Video, Special Announcement, Vehicle Listing
6 of them removed from Search Console reports
and from the Rich Results Test
